timing_contract.api: Public TensorReductionPlan / TensorWorkspace, explicitly selected algorithm and master policy; all arithmetic f64
timing_contract.exclusive: Per-call outer wall time minus the aggregate nested scalar-master wall time
timing_contract.inclusive: Per-call wall time around reduce_batch only; does not include subsequent output checks or I/O
timing_contract.phase_additivity: Arithmetic means of the same calls; exclusive plus masters equals total
timing_contract.selection: Fastest arithmetic mean among the fixed candidate list producing complete finite tensors with measured array-relative error <=1e-3; if none, retain fastest observed timing with a warning and explicit failure/accuracy status
timing_contract.blocks: N<=4: three warmup calls, 11 fixed blocks, loop count calibrated once from final warmup for target30ms capped10000 calls. N>=5: one warmup then five one-call blocks fixed in advance.
timing_contract.precision: All rows ordinary Rust f64: 53 significant bits. Ordinary N5R5/N5R6/N6R6 requested bits39 (internal 2^(19-bits) target approximately1e-6); remaining rows bits53. No higher-precision fallback or promotion.
timing_contract.failure_policy: Successful finite full arrays, internal refusal/Unstable statuses, nonfinite and missing results remain distinct. Refused guarded lanes are null, never unchecked or fabricated zero arrays.
timing_contract.accuracy: Array-relative discrepancy E/A: E=max_j |computed_j-reference_j|/mu^(degree_j+4+2h-2sum(powers)), A=max_j |reference_j|/the same weight. All cumulative tensor moments and four Laurent slots. Also retain historical componentwise mixed normalized error.

input_family.name: E
input_family.embedding: Exact rational strings, exactly representable in all selected binary domains

candidate_policy: Fixed before running: each row explicit NativeF64Abc and Symbolica master policies under its original algorithm; ordinary N6R6 additionally existing Symbolica thin Hybrid/PV with profiling enabled after construction. NativeF64Abc only selects supported A/B/C masters and retains existing Rust/Symbolica fallback for unsupported scalar families. All candidate attempts retained.

selection_notice: Optimistic timing-first binary64 measurements. Fastest mean among fixed candidates with finite complete outputs and measured relative error <=1e-3. Measured accuracy shown separately; requested1e-6 applies onlythree high-point ordinaryrows. Failures and all candidates retained.
statistics: Arithmetic mean of equal-sized block means; standard error descriptive across repeats, not a controlled-host confidence guarantee. Same-call additive master split.
supplemental_selection_notice: Four additional public PV/denominator-order candidates added after original IBP refusals; preserve all initial 38 attempts. No precision or accuracy relaxation and no speed gate.
purpose: Optimistic binary64 opening tables; measured accuracy is annotated separately
collier_strategy_precision_note: DD denotes the Denner-Dittmaier algorithm, not double-double precision; every COLLIER candidate is binary64
